metadata.reader_runtime: xAI Grok 4.6 autonomous agent; macos; interpretation-only reader session in workspace grok-reader
metadata.session_identity: grok-reader-interpretation-only-2026-09-01; freeze before any semantic question set
metadata.workspace_observation: directory listing contained only RESOLVED-CONTRACT.json, INTERPRETATION-RECORD-SCHEMA.json, and READER-TASK.md (the assigned task). No other Contract E, CAL Pipeline, GitHub, repository, implementation, test, evaluator, or reproduction material was retrieved or used.

contract_document_identity.purpose: single-document authority for interpretation-only semantic recoverability testing

authority_character.statement: This resolved artifact is the sole normative authority for this interpretation. It is a research-only resolved semantic view, not a semantic amendment, and is a single-document authority for interpretation-only testing.

resolution_policy.statement: The view is deterministic-only; later amendments govern only their declared scope; no hidden evaluator rules or prior implementation behavior are imported; points marked underdetermined remain underdetermined.

fail_closed_core.statement: A semantic payload has no authority effect unless explicitly bound by a domain warrant.
A generic authorized boolean is forbidden.
fail_closed_core.notes: direct text forbids the boolean; the listed reason generic_authorized_forbidden is the corresponding envelope reason. The envelope field on which such a boolean would appear is not itself specified.

fail_closed_core.statement: A positive result does not self-authorize.
fail_closed_core.notes: direct text; status FORBIDDEN means treating a positive result as self-authorizing is forbidden

fail_closed_core.statement: Competence does not imply jurisdiction, and jurisdiction does not imply competence.
A warrant does not imply operational permission.
A decision does not imply execution permission.
An execution report does not imply a verified outcome.
Later revocation does not rewrite historical validity.
fail_closed_core.notes: direct text; both flags are false

fail_closed_core.statement: Unknown domain, unknown operation, missing required basis, inapplicable, and stale target each reject.
fail_closed_core.notes: direct text. Primary-reason names for unknown domain and inapplicable are listed later; the envelope-level primary reason for stale target is not independently named.

closed_sets.statement: The named authority domains and their listed operations constitute the known domain/operation set in this view. Anything else is unknown and rejects.
closed_sets.notes: necessary inference from the enumerated domain map plus fail-closed unknown behavior and reasons unknown_authority_domain and domain_operation_mismatch

common_envelope.statement: An envelope must declare subject, authority_domain, operation, target, jurisdiction, authority_basis, propagation, non_implications, evaluated_at, participant, and competence.

subject must include id and kind; target must include class, id, and current_hash; jurisdiction must include scope, applicable, and current; each authority_basis entry must include type, id, and current.

On the canonical wire, authority_basis is a required array of AuthorityReference with min_items 1; competence is a required array of Qualification with min_items 0; jurisdiction.scope is a required string; non_implications is a required string array; evaluated_at is a required date-time string.
Envelope-level warrant field cardinality is underdetermined by the source set.
common_envelope.notes: direct text; the same open question is recorded three times

source_access.notes: direct text. accepted_* arrays are empty because the domain object lists none and warrant_allowed/competence_required are false.

assessment_mandate.notes: direct text. Cross-domain use as citation_use is given primary reason authority_basis_domain_mismatch.

numeric_relation.notes: direct text. Warrant licenses numeric_relation.validity and non-implies source_boundary.validity, decision_mandate, citation_use, and task_dispatch.

source_boundary.notes: direct text. Warrant licenses source_boundary.validity and non-implies numeric_relation.validity, semantic_support, decision_mandate, citation_use, and task_dispatch.

decision_mandate.notes: direct text. Unlike other non-informational domains, warrant is allowed and required by domain_basis_requirements. Basis any_of is policy only, not grant. Warrant licenses policy_decision and non-implies epistemic_truth, citation_use, and task_dispatch. Cross-domain use as task_dispatch is given primary reason authority_basis_domain_mismatch.

outcome_verification.notes: direct text. Warrant licenses observed_postcondition and non-implies decision_correctness and execution_permission.

cross_domain_pattern.statement: Operational domains in this view do not require competence and do not allow warrants.
cross_domain_pattern.notes: necessary inference from the four operational domain objects

cross_domain_pattern.statement: Informational domains in this view require competence and allow a typed warrant.
cross_domain_pattern.notes: necessary inference from the three informational domain objects

cross_domain_pattern.statement: Mandate domains are not uniform: assessment_mandate disallows warrants; decision_mandate allows and requires decision-policy-v1 and accepts only policy in any_of.
A warrant supplied for a domain with warrant_allowed false is not allowed.
cross_domain_pattern.notes: necessary inference from warrant_allowed false plus listed reason warrant_not_allowed_for_domain

conferring_types.statement: Authority-conferring reference types are grant, policy, and delegation.

reference_shape.statement: An authority reference must have type, id, and current.

resolved_record_shape.statement: A resolved basis record must have id, type, subject_ids, authority_domain, operations, scopes, target_classes, current, valid_from, and valid_until. Optional fields are target_ids, parent_authority_id, and revoked_at.

matching_rules.statement: A reference id must resolve; reference type must match record type; reference current must not override record currentness; the record must be current for new exercise.

Envelope subject id must be in record.subject_ids; envelope authority_domain must equal record.authority_domain; envelope operation must be in record.operations; jurisdiction.scope must be in record.scopes; target.class must be in record.target_classes; target.id must match when record.target_ids is nonempty; evaluated_at must be within the validity interval.
A supporting artifact reference never satisfies the authority requirement.

ordering.statement: Basis binding is checked before warrant or result payload.

reason_precedence_for_basis.statement: Basis-binding primary reasons have this order: unresolvable_authority_basis, authority_basis_type_mismatch, authority_basis_not_current, authority_basis_subject_mismatch, authority_basis_domain_mismatch, authority_basis_operation_mismatch, authority_basis_scope_mismatch, authority_basis_target_class_mismatch, authority_basis_target_id_mismatch, authority_basis_outside_validity_interval.
reason_precedence_for_basis.notes: direct text; the two lists are identical

non_implications.statement: A current policy identifier without a matching bound record is not authority.
A valid warrant does not repair a missing or mismatched authority basis.
A positive semantic result does not repair a missing or mismatched authority basis.
A typed Decision artifact does not itself satisfy an execution grant requirement.
A supporting artifact may be part of the basis chain without being an authority-conferring record.
non_implications.notes: direct text; this allows presence in a broader chain, not satisfaction of the authority requirement

domain_type_requirements.statement: After basis matching, the bound conferring type must be among the domain's any_of list. decision_mandate any_of is policy only; other listed domains any_of grant or policy.
domain_type_requirements.notes: necessary inference from domain_basis_requirements plus reason missing_domain_authority_basis, which is listed after the matching cascade

supporting_artifact_registry_resolution.statement: Whether a non-authority-conferring supporting artifact reference present in the broader basis chain must resolve through RegistryDocument.records is underdetermined.

shape.statement: A qualification must have type, id, subject_id, scope, and current. current is required for new exercise. A qualification is not an authority basis by itself.
shape.notes: direct text. canonical_wire types: all five fields are strings except current, which is boolean.

envelope_location.statement: Qualifications appear on the envelope as the required competence array, which may be empty at the wire level (min_items 0).
envelope_location.notes: necessary inference: competence item_type is Qualification and is the only envelope field typed as qualification

when_required.statement: Competence is required for numeric_relation, source_boundary, and outcome_verification, using the accepted qualification types numeric_relation_validator, source_boundary_validator, and outcome_verifier respectively.
when_required.notes: direct text. Absence yields missing_required_qualification in the envelope reason list.

listed_failure_reasons.statement: Envelope qualification failures have listed reasons missing_required_qualification, qualification_type_mismatch, qualification_not_current, qualification_subject_mismatch, and qualification_scope_mismatch, in that relative order.
listed_failure_reasons.notes: direct text of the precedence list. Fine-grained matching predicates (how subject_id and scope are compared) are named by those reasons but not spelled as matching_rules analogous to authority_basis.

does_not_imply_jurisdiction_or_basis.statement: Competence does not imply jurisdiction and is not itself an authority basis.

shape.statement: A warrant must have type, id, authority_domain, operation, input_artifact_ids, target_id, target_hash, applicable, and current. It must match envelope domain, operation, and target. applicable and current are required. A warrant is not operational permission.

cardinality.statement: Whether the envelope-level warrant field is exactly one Warrant object, an array of Warrant objects, or another cardinality is underdetermined.
cardinality.notes: direct text; OPEN-WARRANT-CARDINALITY. No preferred cardinality is chosen.

when_required_or_forbidden.statement: Where domain_basis_requirements names a warrant type, that typed warrant is required for the domain.
when_required_or_forbidden.notes: necessary inference from the warrant keys plus missing_required_warrant

when_required_or_forbidden.statement: Where warrant_allowed is false, a warrant is not allowed for the domain.
when_required_or_forbidden.notes: direct text plus listed reason warrant_not_allowed_for_domain

listed_failure_reasons.statement: Envelope warrant failures have listed reasons missing_required_warrant, warrant_domain_mismatch, warrant_operation_mismatch, warrant_type_mismatch, warrant_inapplicable, warrant_not_current, warrant_target_mismatch, warrant_target_hash_mismatch, and warrant_not_allowed_for_domain, in that relative order.

cannot_repair_basis.statement: A valid warrant does not repair a missing or mismatched authority basis and does not confer operational permission.

applies_to.notes: direct text. How much of this conjunction is skipped under historical_inspection is not fully enumerated in this object.

dual_current_flags.statement: authority_reference.current is a fail-closed freshness veto. resolved_basis_record.current is the authoritative lifecycle state. Neither flag overrides the other.

required_conjunction.statement: New exercise requires all of: authority_reference.current == true; resolved_basis_record.current == true; evaluated_at >= valid_from; evaluated_at <= valid_until; and revoked_at absent OR evaluated_at < revoked_at.
required_conjunction.notes: direct text. Validity interval bounds are inclusive. Revocation uses a strict less-than against revoked_at, equivalent to reject when revoked_at is at or before evaluated_at.

primary_reasons.statement: reference_false, record_false, and revoked_at_reached each have canonical primary reason authority_basis_not_current. Outside the validity interval has canonical primary reason authority_basis_outside_validity_interval.
primary_reasons.notes: direct text. Combined with rc3b/rc3c precedence, not_current is selected before outside_validity_interval when both apply.

rules.statement: A participant must be declared, must accept the authority domain, and must accept the operation.
Participant responsibility domain is not inferred from subject identity.
A participant declaration cannot be bypassed by a positive semantic result.

listed_failure_reasons.statement: Envelope participant failures have listed reasons unknown_participant, participant_domain_out_of_scope, and participant_operation_out_of_scope, in that relative order, after unknown_authority_domain and domain_operation_mismatch.

closed_participant_set.statement: Only the eight named participant declarations are known participants. Any other participant identifier is unknown_participant.
closed_participant_set.notes: necessary inference from the enumerated map plus unknown_participant

excluded_versus_unaccepted.statement: accepted_domains/accepted_operations are the positive participant-acceptance checks. excluded_responsibilities are declared non-responsibilities and are not a complete complement of all other domains.
excluded_versus_unaccepted.notes: direct text for the positive checks. The excluded lists omit some non-accepted domains, so exclusion-by-silence is not stated.

never_implicit.statement: competence, authority_domain, jurisdiction, warrant, semantic_validity, decision_mandate, citation_use, task_dispatch, and outcome_verification never propagate implicitly.

identity_provenance_fields.statement: Identity-provenance fields are source_id, artifact_id, content_hash, producer_id, policy_id, and policy_version.
identity_provenance_fields.notes: direct text in this document. shape.identity_provenance_only.allowed_fields_source points at SPEC-CANDIDATE.json, which is not inlined beyond these restated fields.

modes.statement: Mode identity_provenance_only allows the identity-provenance field set.
modes.notes: necessary inference that the restated identity_provenance_fields are the allowed set in this resolved view

modes.statement: Mode explicit requires a fields array. Authority fields remain forbidden unless separately reauthorized.
modes.notes: direct text. What counts as separate reauthorization, and the exact membership of 'authority fields' versus never_implicit, is not fully defined.

canonical_interface.statement: When EvaluationRequest.kind is propagation, the request container key is request, and mode is required as one of none, identity_provenance_only, explicit.

fields is required when mode is explicit and defaults to [] when absent for other modes. separately_reauthorized is an optional boolean. requested_fields is a forbidden native alias and rejects with malformed_propagation_request.
Unknown propagation mode rejects with unknown_propagation_mode.

relisted_authority_reestablishment.statement: Explicit decision_mandate propagation and explicit task_dispatch propagation have relisted primary reason authority_requires_reestablishment.
relisted_authority_reestablishment.notes: direct text. These reasons are relisted but are not members of whole_envelope_precedence.

inherited_constraints.statement: A delegation child must be a subset of its parent, cannot extend parent expiry, cannot add an operation not in the parent, and cannot expand scope.

required_child_fields.statement: A delegation child must have id, delegator, delegate, authority_domain, operations, scope, current, and parent_authority_id. operations and scope are arrays with min_items 1.

parent_record.statement: A parent authority record must have id, authority_domain, operations, scope, and current. It is not required to have delegator, delegate, or parent_authority_id. Its semantic role is upstream authority whose delegated child must not amplify domain, operation, scope, currentness, or expiry.
parent_record.notes: direct text. Field name is scope (array), unlike resolved_basis_record.scopes.

request_rules.statement: When kind is delegation, parent, child, and mode are required. mode is new_exercise or historical_inspection. Unknown mode rejects with unknown_evaluation_mode.
child.parent_authority_id must equal parent.id or reject with delegation_parent_mismatch.
child.authority_domain must equal parent.authority_domain or reject with delegation_domain_amplification.
child.operations must be a subset of parent.operations or reject with delegation_operation_amplification.
child.scope must be a subset of parent.scope or reject with delegation_scope_amplification.
For new_exercise, parent.current and child.current must both be true or reject with delegation_not_current.
request_rules.notes: direct text. The rule is named only for new_exercise.

request_rules.statement: If parent.valid_until exists, child.valid_until must exist and be <= parent.valid_until, else reject with delegation_expiry_amplification.
request_rules.notes: direct text of the request rule. A different formulation exists at canonical_wire.expiry_rule; see claimed_contradictions.

nonclaim.statement: This view does not infer delegator/principal equality because no authoritative parent-principal field is frozen.
nonclaim.notes: direct text: equality is not inferred; the relation remains unset rather than affirmed or denied

core.statement: Exercised authority requires evaluated_at and authority_basis. Current recheck is required for a new action. Later revocation does not rewrite prior valid-at-time.
core.notes: direct text; all rewrite flags are false

record_shape.statement: A historical record must have evaluated_at, authority_was_valid_at_time, and authority_basis_ids. Later currentness may be false. Later revocation does not rewrite authority_was_valid_at_time. New exercise requires current recheck.

request.statement: When kind is historical, record and mode are required. Native modes are historical_inspection and new_exercise. historical_record is a fixture-only token and is not a native mode. Unknown mode rejects with unknown_evaluation_mode; silent default is forbidden.
historical_inspection evaluates authority_was_valid_at_time as stored; later currentness/revocation does not rewrite it.
new_exercise: historical validity alone cannot authorize; current authority is required. If only a historical record is present, reject with authority_basis_not_current.

opacity.statement: The result payload is opaque to the common validator.

no_authority_from_result_fields.statement: positive status has no authority effect; success has no authority effect; confidence has no authority effect.
no_authority_from_result_fields.notes: direct text; FORBIDDEN means treating those fields as authority-conferring is forbidden

no_authority_from_result_fields.statement: A positive result does not self-authorize and does not repair a missing or mismatched authority basis.

warrant_bound_exception.statement: Semantic payload authority effect is none unless explicitly bound by a domain warrant. The listed warrant licenses are numeric_relation.validity, source_boundary.validity, policy_decision, and observed_postcondition. Those licenses still do not imply operational permission, execution permission, or the warrant-type non-implications.
warrant_bound_exception.notes: direct text combined with warrant license lists. The exception is the warrant binding, not the result object's status/success/confidence fields.

evaluation_request.statement: EvaluationRequest is an object with required kind. kind is one of envelope, propagation, delegation, historical. Unknown kind rejects with unknown_evaluation_kind; silent default is forbidden.

envelope_request.statement: When kind is envelope, envelope, registry, and mode are required. mode is new_exercise or historical_inspection. Unknown mode rejects with unknown_evaluation_mode; silent default is forbidden. registry is a RegistryDocument.

registry_document.statement: RegistryDocument is an object with required schema (nonempty string) and records (object mapping authority_record_id to ResolvedBasisRecord). map key must equal record.id. A native document wrapper is required for cross-repository conformance. A bare record map may be an internal representation. Comparison must not extract records before the consumer call. Malformed registry has reason malformed_registry_document.

consumer_requirements.statement: A consumer must consume the registry document natively and the canonical request wrapper natively; must reject unknown kind or mode; must reject requested_fields on a native propagation request; must not require hidden fixture-DSL knowledge; must not require a bespoke post-reveal adapter.

fixture_boundary.statement: Fixture DSL is not native consumer wire. A materializer may only apply frozen baseline overlays, map fixture field names and case-mode labels to canonical names/tokens, construct the EvaluationRequest wrapper, and otherwise preserve canonical payload bytes. A materializer must not repair consumer output, coerce malformed wire, invent missing authority semantics, inspect the consumer, or select transformations based on observed consumer result, and must not change authority semantics.
fixture_boundary.notes: direct text. These are constraints on evaluation packaging, not additional authority rules.

decision_normativity.statement: For envelope evaluation under the rc3c reason contract and for the rc3d interface, the decision (accept/reject) is normative.

single_primary_reason.statement: A single primary reason is required.

when_reason_string_is_normative.statement: A canonical primary reason string is normative only when listed by the rc3c amendment, by rc3b basis binding, or, for interface reasons, by the rc3d canonical_primary_reasons list. Inherited rc3a reason strings are historical and non-normative unless explicitly relisted. Inherited authority reasons remain governed by rc3b/rc3c.

whole_envelope_precedence.notes: direct text; first matching failure is the single primary reason by necessary inference from single_primary_reason plus this ordered list

malformed_wire_mappings.statement: authority_basis not array -> malformed_authority_basis_shape; competence not array -> malformed_competence_shape; jurisdiction.scope not string -> malformed_jurisdiction_scope_shape; qualification.scope not string -> malformed_qualification_scope_shape; delegation operations not array -> malformed_delegation_operations_shape; delegation scope not array -> malformed_delegation_scope_shape.
malformed_wire_mappings.notes: direct text for the mappings. The first four also appear in whole_envelope_precedence. The two delegation malformed reasons do not appear in whole_envelope_precedence or in rc3d canonical_primary_reasons.

relisted_cross_domain.statement: assessment_mandate used as citation_use -> authority_basis_domain_mismatch; decision_mandate used as task_dispatch -> authority_basis_domain_mismatch; explicit decision_mandate propagation -> authority_requires_reestablishment; explicit task_dispatch propagation -> authority_requires_reestablishment; delegation operation/scope/expiry amplification keep those named reasons.

rc3d_interface_reasons.notes: direct text. These are interface/delegation/propagation packaging reasons, not a replacement of the envelope basis cascade.

underdeterminations.question: Is the envelope-level warrant field exactly one Warrant object, an array of Warrant objects, or another cardinality?
underdeterminations.why_not_decided: Explicitly marked UNDERDETERMINED_BY_SOURCE_SET in common_envelope.warrant_field_cardinality, warrant.envelope_field_cardinality, and explicit_open_normative_questions. Warrant is also absent from common_envelope.required_fields and from canonical_wire.

underdeterminations.question: Must a non-authority-conferring supporting artifact reference present in the broader basis chain resolve through RegistryDocument.records?
underdeterminations.why_not_decided: Explicitly marked UNDERDETERMINED_BY_SOURCE_SET. Supporting artifacts never satisfy the authority requirement, but registry-resolution obligation for non-conferring references is not stated.

underdeterminations.question: If authority_basis contains multiple conferring references, must every item match, or does any one matching domain-eligible item suffice?
underdeterminations.why_not_decided: canonical_wire requires an array with min_items 1 but states no conjunction/disjunction rule among items.

underdeterminations.question: What is the canonical primary reason for an empty authority_basis array (type-correct but min_items 1 failed)?
underdeterminations.why_not_decided: malformed_authority_basis_shape is mapped only from authority_basis_not_array. missing_required_field and missing_domain_authority_basis are also listed. No mapping chooses among them for empty array.

underdeterminations.question: Does a bound basis record of type delegation satisfy a domain any_of list that names grant and/or policy but not delegation?
underdeterminations.why_not_decided: authority_conferring_types include delegation, but every domain_basis_requirements.any_of list names only grant and/or policy. No rule says a delegation of a policy/grant counts as that parent type.

underdeterminations.question: If competence contains extra qualifications for a domain that does not require competence, or extra types beyond the accepted type, is that rejected or ignored?
underdeterminations.why_not_decided: competence min_items is 0 and competence_required is false for several domains, but no surplus-qualification rule is stated. qualification_type_mismatch exists but is not scoped to surplus entries.

underdeterminations.question: How surplus or additional warrants are treated, including for domains that allow one typed warrant, given that envelope cardinality itself is open.
underdeterminations.why_not_decided: Warrant cardinality is explicitly underdetermined; no surplus rule is stated.

underdeterminations.question: What is the shape of the required envelope field named propagation, as distinct from EvaluationRequest kind=propagation?
underdeterminations.why_not_decided: propagation is in common_envelope.required_fields, but canonical_wire does not type it. The detailed propagation canonical_interface applies when_kind is propagation, with request container key request.

underdeterminations.question: What strings must or may appear in envelope.non_implications?
underdeterminations.why_not_decided: The field is a required string array, but no permitted/required vocabulary is given.

underdeterminations.question: On which object/field would a generic authorized boolean appear such that generic_authorized_forbidden applies?
underdeterminations.why_not_decided: generic_authorized_boolean_forbidden is true and the reason is listed, but no envelope or result field named authorized is specified.

underdeterminations.question: What canonical primary reason applies to stale_target_behavior=reject at envelope evaluation, as distinct from warrant_target_hash_mismatch?
underdeterminations.why_not_decided: stale_target_behavior is reject and target.current_hash is required, but no envelope reason is named for hash staleness outside warrant matching.

underdeterminations.question: What JSON types and exact predicates apply to jurisdiction.applicable and jurisdiction.current?
underdeterminations.why_not_decided: They are required names. inapplicable_behavior is reject, and reasons jurisdiction_inapplicable and jurisdiction_not_current exist, but canonical_wire types only jurisdiction.scope.

underdeterminations.question: Does subject.kind have any matching or closed-set constraint?
underdeterminations.why_not_decided: subject_required includes kind, but authority-basis matching uses only subject id against record.subject_ids.

underdeterminations.question: What are the exact predicates for qualification subject and scope matching (against envelope subject.id and jurisdiction.scope, or against qualification.scope as a free string)?
underdeterminations.why_not_decided: Reasons qualification_subject_mismatch and qualification_scope_mismatch are listed, and qualification.scope is a string, but no matching_rules object is given for qualifications.

underdeterminations.question: Beyond being a required binding, must input_artifact_ids resolve, match registry records, or match other envelope fields?
underdeterminations.why_not_decided: required_bindings include input_artifact_ids; no further matching rule is stated.

underdeterminations.question: What constitutes separate reauthorization that would allow authority fields under explicit propagation, and which fields are 'authority fields'?
underdeterminations.why_not_decided: explicit.authority_fields_still_forbidden_unless_separately_reauthorized is true and separately_reauthorized is an optional boolean, but the reauthorization procedure and the authority-field set are not defined. never_implicit is a related but not identical list.

underdeterminations.question: Which additional SPEC-CANDIDATE propagation rules, if any, apply beyond the rules inlined in this resolved view?
underdeterminations.why_not_decided: canonical_interface.semantic_rules says to inherit SPEC-CANDIDATE propagation rules and RC3C relisted reasons. SPEC-CANDIDATE is not inlined except for identity_provenance_fields restated here. Retrieval of that blob is outside the authorized aperture.

underdeterminations.question: For delegation mode historical_inspection, must parent.current and child.current be true?
underdeterminations.why_not_decided: currentness_rule_for_new_exercise is stated only for new_exercise. No historical_inspection currentness rule is given.

underdeterminations.question: Are parent/child valid_from (or resolved-record validity intervals other than valid_until) checked in the delegation evaluation kind?
underdeterminations.why_not_decided: Delegation request rules cover linkage, domain, operations, scope, currentness for new_exercise, and valid_until expiry. valid_from is a resolved_basis_record field, not a ParentAuthorityRecord/DelegationChild required field.

underdeterminations.question: May a ResolvedBasisRecord be used as ParentAuthorityRecord despite field-name and required-field differences (scope vs scopes; extra required fields on the resolved record)?
underdeterminations.why_not_decided: The two shapes are specified separately. No conversion or identity rule is stated.

underdeterminations.question: What primary reason applies if delegation operations or scope is an empty array rather than a non-array?
underdeterminations.why_not_decided: min_items 1 is stated, but malformed_delegation_* reasons are mapped only from not-array conditions, and amplification reasons assume comparable arrays.

underdeterminations.question: Are malformed_delegation_operations_shape and malformed_delegation_scope_shape normative canonical primary reasons?
underdeterminations.why_not_decided: They are mapped in rc3c_malformed_wire_reasons, but they are not in whole_envelope_precedence and not in rc3d_interface.canonical_primary_reasons, while rc3c says a canonical primary reason is normative only when listed by that amendment or rc3b basis binding.

underdeterminations.question: Where does authority_requires_reestablishment sit relative to whole_envelope_precedence, and does it apply to envelope kind, propagation kind, or both?
underdeterminations.why_not_decided: It is relisted for explicit decision_mandate/task_dispatch propagation but is not a member of whole_envelope_precedence.

underdeterminations.question: What is the relationship between EvaluationRequest kind=historical and envelope request mode=historical_inspection?
underdeterminations.why_not_decided: Both exist as first-class interface options with overlapping mode tokens but different required payloads (historical record vs envelope+registry).

underdeterminations.question: Which currentness and matching checks are skipped or retained when envelope mode is historical_inspection?
underdeterminations.why_not_decided: currentness.applies_to is new_exercise, and historical inspection semantics are stated for stored authority_was_valid_at_time. The envelope historical_inspection path does not enumerate a reduced check set.

underdeterminations.question: Are excluded_responsibilities independently enforced, and with what reason, or are they non-implication labels beside accepted_domains/operations checks?
underdeterminations.why_not_decided: Participant fail-closed rules named are declaration, domain acceptance, and operation acceptance. No reason is named for excluded_responsibilities. The excluded lists are not complements of unaccepted domains.

underdeterminations.question: What canonical-wire formats apply to resolved_basis_record.valid_from, valid_until, and revoked_at?
underdeterminations.why_not_decided: Those fields are required or optional on the semantic record, but canonical_wire_resolved_record types only some array/boolean fields and omits the temporal fields. Parent valid_until is date-time when present.

underdeterminations.question: Must propagation, delegation, or historical EvaluationRequest kinds include a RegistryDocument?
underdeterminations.why_not_decided: envelope_request requires registry. Propagation required is only mode. Delegation required is parent, child, mode. Historical required is record, mode.

underdeterminations.question: Is the primary reason for an unknown operation on a known domain always domain_operation_mismatch, or is there an unlisted unknown-operation reason?
underdeterminations.why_not_decided: unknown_operation_behavior is reject. whole_envelope_precedence lists domain_operation_mismatch and not a separate unknown_operation token.

claimed_contradictions.description: Delegation expiry constraints are not equivalent across locations. request.expiry_rule requires that if parent.valid_until exists, child.valid_until must exist and be <= parent.valid_until. canonical_wire.expiry_rule only requires child.valid_until <= parent.valid_until when both are present, which would allow a child that omits valid_until while the parent has one. inherited_semantics.cannot_extend_parent_expiry is true but does not define whether omitting child.valid_until is an extension.
claimed_contradictions.material_effect: The same parent-with-valid_until / child-without-valid_until case would reject with delegation_expiry_amplification under the request rule and could be treated as unconstrained under the canonical_wire 'when both are present' rule.

load_bearing_assumptions.assumption: For this experiment, RESOLVED-CONTRACT.json is the only normative authority; source_blobs and provenance_index are origin pointers, not additional texts to be retrieved or applied.
load_bearing_assumptions.needed_for: Reading the resolved view as a closed semantic artifact

load_bearing_assumptions.assumption: The enumerated authority_domains and participant_declarations are closed sets; names not listed are unknown and reject.
load_bearing_assumptions.needed_for: Interpreting unknown_domain, unknown_operation, and unknown_participant behavior

load_bearing_assumptions.assumption: When domain_basis_requirements includes qualification or warrant keys, those typed objects are required for that domain, satisfied via competence entries and a warrant attachment whose envelope cardinality remains open.
load_bearing_assumptions.needed_for: Connecting domain objects to missing_required_qualification and missing_required_warrant

load_bearing_assumptions.assumption: domain_basis_requirements.any_of constrains the authority-conferring type of the bound record(s) after matching; missing_domain_authority_basis is the listed reason after the matching cascade.
load_bearing_assumptions.needed_for: Interpreting decision_mandate policy-only basis versus grant/policy domains

load_bearing_assumptions.assumption: single_primary_reason plus an ordered list means the earliest listed applicable failure is the canonical primary reason for that evaluation pathway.
The identity_provenance_fields restated in this document are the identity-provenance allow-list in this view, even though identity_provenance_only also cites SPEC-CANDIDATE.json.
load_bearing_assumptions.needed_for: Giving identity_provenance_only a determinate field set without retrieving SPEC-CANDIDATE

load_bearing_assumptions.assumption: EvaluationRequest kinds are distinct evaluation pathways. Envelope reason precedence governs kind=envelope. rc3d canonical_primary_reasons govern interface/kind/mode/registry/propagation-alias/delegation-request failures. Relisted reasons apply where their triggering conditions apply.
load_bearing_assumptions.needed_for: Not collapsing delegation/historical/propagation kinds into the envelope cascade

load_bearing_assumptions.assumption: JSON pointers in this record refer to RESOLVED-CONTRACT.json as materialized, using zero-based array indices for explicit_open_normative_questions.
load_bearing_assumptions.needed_for: Citation discipline required by the reader task

falsifiers.claim: Envelope warrant cardinality is underdetermined and no preferred cardinality is adopted.
falsifiers.observation_that_would_falsify_it: This resolved artifact, without leaving the source set, froze warrant as exactly one object, exactly an array, or another definite cardinality.

falsifiers.claim: Non-conferring supporting-artifact registry resolution is underdetermined.
falsifiers.observation_that_would_falsify_it: This resolved artifact stated that such references must, or must not, resolve through RegistryDocument.records.

falsifiers.claim: A positive result, success flag, or confidence value has no authority effect and cannot self-authorize or repair basis failure.
falsifiers.observation_that_would_falsify_it: This resolved artifact treated positive_result_self_authorizes, positive_status_has_no_authority_effect, success_has_no_authority_effect, or confidence_has_no_authority_effect as false, or stated that a positive semantic result repairs missing/mismatched basis.

falsifiers.claim: Later revocation does not rewrite historical authority_was_valid_at_time.
falsifiers.observation_that_would_falsify_it: historical_validity_rewritten_by_later_revocation, later_revocation_rewrites_history, or later_revocation_does_not_rewrite_authority_was_valid_at_time were the opposite of the false/true values in this view.

falsifiers.claim: Competence does not imply jurisdiction and is not itself an authority basis.
falsifiers.observation_that_would_falsify_it: competence_implies_jurisdiction were true, or qualification_is_not_authority_basis_by_itself were false.

falsifiers.claim: A warrant is not operational permission and cannot repair a missing or mismatched authority basis.
falsifiers.observation_that_would_falsify_it: warrant_implies_operational_permission or warrant_is_not_operational_permission were reversed, or a valid warrant were stated to repair basis failure.

falsifiers.claim: decision_mandate basis any_of is policy only, not grant.
falsifiers.observation_that_would_falsify_it: domain_basis_requirements.decision_mandate.any_of included grant or other types besides policy.

falsifiers.claim: New exercise requires the currentness conjunction of reference.current, record.current, inclusive validity interval, and uneclipsed revoked_at.
falsifiers.observation_that_would_falsify_it: reference_true_cannot_override_noncurrent_record, reference_false_must_reject_even_when_record_current, or validity_interval_bounds were reversed, or revoked_at equality were treated as still current.

falsifiers.claim: Default authority propagation is none, and listed never_implicit fields do not propagate implicitly.
falsifiers.observation_that_would_falsify_it: default_authority_propagation were a mode other than none, or never_implicit omitted those fields or allowed implicit authority_domain/jurisdiction/warrant/competence propagation.

falsifiers.claim: Unknown EvaluationRequest kind or mode rejects with unknown_evaluation_kind / unknown_evaluation_mode and silent default is forbidden.
falsifiers.observation_that_would_falsify_it: unknown_kind_behavior or unknown_mode_behavior used a silent default or a non-reject decision.

falsifiers.claim: historical_record is not a native historical mode.
falsifiers.observation_that_would_falsify_it: mode.enum included historical_record, or fixture_token_is_not_native_mode were false.

falsifiers.claim: The requested_fields alias on native propagation requests must reject with malformed_propagation_request.
falsifiers.observation_that_would_falsify_it: forbidden_alias_behavior used a decision other than reject, or requested_fields were an accepted native field.

falsifiers.claim: The two delegation expiry formulations contradict on omitted child.valid_until.
falsifiers.observation_that_would_falsify_it: One of the two expiry_rule strings were absent, or a unifying rule stated that omitted child.valid_until is or is not expiry amplification.

falsifiers.claim: Participant identity/responsibility is not inferred from subject identity and is not bypassed by a positive semantic result.
Basis binding is checked before warrant or result payload.
falsifiers.observation_that_would_falsify_it: basis_binding_checked_before_warrant_or_result_payload were false, or reason precedence placed warrant reasons before unresolvable/mismatched basis reasons.
